lines.text: Three slow breaths. Follow the voice.
Okay. Now let your breathing return to normal, and just watch it.
For the next seven minutes, there's nothing to do but notice.
Rest your attention on the breath, wherever you feel it most.
When you hear this sound, come back to the breath.
Your mind will wander. That's fine. Noticing that it wandered is the whole practice.
If you're lost in a thought, no problem. Let it go, and feel the next breath.
There's nothing to get right. Just this breath, and then the next one.
Let the practice go now. Notice how you feel.
Feel your hands and feet. When you're ready, open your eyes.
